semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Winkler AG provides specialized heating solutions and components that are integral to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Winkler AG develops and produces flexible electrical heating solutions, including furnaces, ovens, and heat treating systems, for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include heating elements, temperature control solutions, and innovative systems like heated tubing for gas analysis. They emphasize high-quality manufacturing and offer both standard and custom solutions.
capabilities: Furnaces and ovens for semiconductor manufacturing
Heated tubing for gas analysis and exhaust measurement
